# Dezeen

> > The world's most influential architecture and design magazine, covering contemporary projects, sustainable design innovations, and the work of leading architects and designers.

Dezeen features award-winning architecture, mass timber construction, healthcare design, and projects by renowned architects including David Chipperfield, Snøhetta, and Smiljan Radić. The magazine covers buildings and design work from around the globe, with particular focus on sustainable design practices and innovative building technologies.

## Key Topics

- Contemporary architecture
- Sustainable design
- Mass timber construction
- Architecture awards
- David Chipperfield
- Snøhetta
- Smiljan Radić
- Pritzker Architecture Prize
- Healthcare design
- Montgomery Sisam Architects
- Twentieth Century Society
- Building projects
- Natural lighting
- Glass partitions
- Patient-centered design
